title: The Three "Lost" Parables
intro: Jesus tells three parables in response to criticism from the Pharisees: "This man welcomes sinners and eats with them." All are about the joy of finding what was lost.

items.title: The Lost Sheep
items.text: A shepherd leaves ninety-nine sheep to find the one that is lost. When he finds it, he carries it home with joy and celebrates with friends. In the same way, there is joy in heaven over one sinner who repents.

items.title: The Lost Coin
items.text: A woman has ten silver coins and loses one. She lights a lamp, sweeps the house and searches until she finds it. In the same way, there is joy among God's angels over one sinner who repents.

items.title: The Lost Son
items.text: The younger son takes his inheritance and squanders it. He ends up feeding pigs, but returns home. The father runs to meet him, embraces him and throws a feast. The older brother becomes angry, but the father says: "We had to celebrate, because this brother of yours was dead and is now alive."
